issue: Cart abandonment was shown as 81.3% in the README and the Module 2 report.
root_cause: The value is 81.25%, and it was rounded differently in different places.
impact: One headline number in two documents and the slide deck did not match.
action: Changed to 81.2% in the README, the Module 2 report and the deck.

issue: Documents said the dev and test labels were hand-labelled. They were made by an AI assistant in one pass.
root_cause: Wrong wording carried over from earlier documents.
impact: Readers could trust the reference labels more than they should. No result numbers changed.
action: Wording corrected in comments and documents; file and column names kept so scripts still run. A person blind-labelled 30 test reviews (kappa 0.67 vs AI labels).

issue: Prompt v1 over-tagged: dev precision 0.76, and 2 of 167 quotes were not exact.
root_cause: The prompt counted praise and stages only mentioned as background; two quotes changed capital letters.
impact: Too many false labels (top errors FP AP=11, FP CP=8).
action: Wrote v2 with the problems-only and where-it-happens rules. v2 dev precision 0.94, all quotes exact.

issue: Prompt v3 did not clearly beat v2 and had 2 inexact quotes of 132.
root_cause: Changes for short complaints also added over-tagging.
impact: No gain once run-to-run change was counted (v2 micro F1 0.93, v3 0.92).
action: Froze v2 before any test run.

issue: The LLM gives different labels when run again: same labels on 88% of dev reviews for v2 (85% for v3).
root_cause: Sampling cannot be fixed: the API rejects the temperature setting.
impact: Test scores come from one run and could move on a rerun.
action: Measured repeatability and reported it; included as a 12% repeat-run change rate in the vendor scorecard.

issue: On the person's first 30 labels the LLM gave RS (refunds and customer service) 6 false tags; the person gave RS to no review.
root_cause: Different reading of the RS definition between the person and the prompt.
impact: LLM micro F1 0.65 vs rules 0.71 on the 30; without RS they were almost equal (0.71 vs 0.73).
action: Wrote the RS rule and edge cases into the labelling guideline (2026-11-17).

issue: The blind-label worksheet came back from Excel in a Windows code page, not UTF-8. It happened again on 2026-11-17 (Windows-1252).
root_cause: Excel's plain CSV save uses the system code page.
impact: The agreement scripts could not read the file.
action: Script 00b reads GBK; script 00d reads UTF-8, GBK or Windows-1252. Labels are ASCII codes, so they are not affected.

issue: Retry reasons were not logged: the full run had 2 retries with no recorded cause.
root_cause: The client keeps the error message only for reviews that fail after all retries.
impact: Parse-error and refusal counts are NOT AVAILABLE.
action: Not fixed: the tagging scripts are frozen. Next version should log the reason for every retry.

issue: Wall-clock run time was not logged.
root_cause: Only per-review latency was recorded; calls ran on 8 parallel workers.
impact: Real LLM throughput is NOT AVAILABLE; the scorecard uses reviews per minute per worker.
action: Not fixed: scripts are frozen. Next version should log run start and end times.

issue: Vendor quality result depends on the labelling round. First 30 (labelled before the test run): rules F1 0.71, LLM 0.65. Other 70 (labelled after results were published): rules 0.60, LLM 0.72.
root_cause: Unknown. Possible causes: the 70 were labelled after the person had seen the results, or chance in small samples.
impact: The LLM's quality lead on all 100 (F1 0.70 vs 0.63) is not settled.
action: Reported both rounds in the scorecard. Next step: label a fresh blind sample before looking at any tagger output.

issue: API prices used for all costs are not verified.
root_cause: Prices come from a table cached on 2026-10-06 in src/llm_client.py.
impact: All cost figures ($0.5585 in total by token count) may be off.
action: Prices marked VERIFY in config/pricing.yaml. Owner to check the pricing page and enter the console bill.
